opennyai_summary.decision:
Therefore, it is humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to admit this Writ application issue rule NISI for calling upon the opp. Parties to show cause as to why a direction will not be issued to the Opp. Parties to compensate the petitioner under provisions of Odisha Resettlement and Rehabilitation Policy, 2006 in terms of Notification dated 15.11.2006 (annexure-2) and provisions Under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013;
And pass other order(s)/direction as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit just and proper in this case.
As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.6 to consider the representation filed by the petitioners vide Annexure-5 series,
and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
